en: Welcome to the Oceanic Museum. The entrance fee is 50 Poké Dollars. Would you like to come in?
Thank you. Please enjoy the museum!
I'm sorry, but you don't have enough money.
Oh, you're with that group that went upstairs? Go right in, then. Hurry, they're waiting!
Aaah! It's you, the kid from the tunnel! Don't look at me like that. I'm just a visitor today!
Here, take this and forget you ever saw me. Please!
Now leave me alone! I hope I never see you again!
